# Define runtime and admission continuity across Fleet updates

## Context

Fleet updates currently require managed seats to stop because their native MCP executable/runtime lives in the replaceable app bundle. Relocating those files alone is insufficient: the admission issuer loses its in-memory grants and listener on restart. The [October 13 installed receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/12#issuecomment-6149794862) records 31 minutes 18 seconds from checkpoint request to installation, before recipient recovery.

## The Problem

[D19723](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/19723) converged on immutable runtime generations plus verified recovery of the existing profile capability after a clean, durably proved issuer handoff. Accepted ADR 0038 currently invalidates all grants on issuer replacement. This leaf makes the explicit authority amendment first; it does not deliver runtime continuity or close the existing implementation work.

Design authority: D19723's 2026-10-13T19:00:49Z fold and the signals below.

## The Architectural Reality

- Engine `learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md` §2.5 owns whole-package distribution.
- Engine `learn/agentos/decisions/0038-fm-client-topology.md` row 8 and §2.5.2 own native admission custody and lifetime.
- Brain `ai/services/fleet/McpLaunchAdmissionService.mjs` at `d628999a` keeps grants/inputs in memory; `listen()` allocates an ephemeral port and `destroy()` revokes all grants without awaiting listener close.
- Runtime identity and a managed Start's revocable admission authority are separate. The profile and lease cannot manufacture a missing original authorization.

## The Fix

Amend both existing ADRs in one documentation PR, preserving their owning paths. Record the selected contract and rejected alternatives from D19723. Runtime implementation remains in neomjs/neo-agent-institution#674 and neomjs/neo-agent-brain#980; those changes merge after this authority amendment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: ADR 0034 records package identity/integrity, complete executable closure, actual-Start pin, live/unknown seat and child retention, rollback reachability, race-free retirement and unchanged canonical installer guard.
- [ ] AC-2: ADR 0038 records original-Start authority, durable phases and consumed/fenced handoff proof, verified read of the existing owned capability, same-origin rebind, full original-owner input recovery including Bridge authority, and sticky revocation with a final post-proof fence.
- [ ] AC-3: Both ADRs preserve explicit legacy migration and delivery bounds. Name the lost-revocation crash/replayed-handoff negatives and clean-handoff positive; profile writes during a running Desktop session must preserve the owned capability or refuse. Running process/existing tools and new-child admission remain distinct.
- [ ] AC-4: Record the source/fixture limits and installed surviving-seat/later-child witness as consumer obligations; preserve all other credential classes and the whole-package update decision. Cross-links resolve; no runtime success is claimed.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping

- Q1 + Q2 → AC-2: original authority, existing capability carrier and full input-owner contract.
- Q3 → AC-1–3: revocation, retirement, durable succession and truthful UI state.
- Q4 → AC-3: explicit legacy and endpoint transition.
- Step-Back point 4 → AC-2–3; [confirmation](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19723#discussioncomment-18907425).
- Step-Back point 5 partial → AC-4 records production/installed acceptance on the existing consumers; this docs leaf does not claim to satisfy it.

## Unresolved Dissent

None at the approved fold. Emmy's durability partial is [addressed](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19723#discussioncomment-18907425); production fixtures and installed UX remain delivery obligations.

## Unresolved Liveness

No absence is treated as consent. Active GPT and Claude signals satisfy this architecture change's quorum; inactive-family approval is neither needed nor inferred.

## Out of Scope

Runtime implementation, live profile/credential changes, automatic update feeds/signing, vendor-harness updates, model selection and window placement. No ADR moves.

## Avoided Traps

A runtime path is not admission authority; hashes cannot sign HMAC; an old active record cannot prove no revocation was lost. Do not add a second secret class, reconstruct authority from a lease, reuse a clean handoff after a crash, or label a running seat stopped because new admission failed. Transitional guidance retires only after executable delivery and the installed witness.
